app.word: Converts HEIC and HEIF photos from iPhones into AVIF so that they display normally in posts, instead of appearing as unusable download links. Conversion runs in the background and never prevents a member from posting.
This server can convert HEIC to AVIF.
Conversion is not possible on this server.
Details of the failures are in the system logs, category “heicuploads”.
Blocked conversions have been queued again.

The starting point has not been set, so detection is suspended and no new photo will be converted. This happens when installation was interrupted at its last step. Reinstall the application from Applications to set it.

When enabled, HEIC and HEIF photos uploaded by members are converted to AVIF so that browsers can display them. Turn this off to stop all conversion without uninstalling the application; photos already converted are unaffected.

Quality of the converted full-size image. Lower means smaller files and more visible artefacts. 65 is a good balance: on a 12 MP iPhone photo it produces roughly 90 KB. This is separate from the site-wide "JPG and WebP quality" setting, which does not apply here.

Quality of the thumbnail shown inside posts. Thumbnails are also AVIF and are generated from the original photo, not from the converted image, so there is no double compression. A low value is fine here because the thumbnail is displayed small.

How the photo is downscaled. Catrom is recommended: on this server it measured 1.87 s versus 2.37 s for Lanczos, for a visually equivalent result. Triangle is marginally faster but softer — its smaller files are the result of lost detail, not better compression.

AVIF encoder effort, from 0 (slowest) to 9 (fastest). Measurements on this server showed speed 9 producing the same file size as speed 6 while being seven times faster, so there is rarely any reason to lower it. Only change this if you have measured a difference on your own hardware.

CPU threads allocated to each conversion. Beyond 2 the gain measured here was nil while CPU cost doubled, which penalises the rest of the forum when several members upload at once. Raise this only with measurements to back it up.
